description: Use this when the user asks what theatre is on this weekend or next. Server-side date math resolves the Friday/Saturday/Sunday dates; returns theatre shows in the city with scheduled performances on those days, grouped by day. Schedule data, not live seat inventory.

city.description: City name, resolved to a slug.

format.description: Response shape. 'json' returns structured records; 'text' returns the same content rendered as a short narrative paragraph for chat surfaces.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

limit.description: Max shows to return. Defaults to 20.

name: get_theatre_weekend
